nodes.name: Every 6h
nodes.notes: ADR-054 Block 3 (upgraded 2026-07-02): REAL tool-connectivity dead-man's-switch for the hosted ClickUp MCP (mcp.clickup.com/mcp) that the tier agents use for caller-scoped discovery. Prior version only GET-pinged the PUBLIC OAuth well-known URL — which returns 2xx even when the harness cannot actually connect the MCP + inject a per-user token (exactly the 2026-07-01 silent failure: tools denied, well-known still 200). This now opens a real minimal probe session (cheap Haiku agent + Franciszek's ClickUp vault) and calls clickup_get_workspace_hierarchy in-harness — the same path a real task uses — so a genuine connection failure is caught within ~6h instead of at the next real task.

nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Test entry for Definition-of-Done verification via scripts/test-subworkflow.mjs (a Schedule Trigger cannot be fired over the n8n API). No inputs needed.

nodes.name: Fetch Probe Inputs
nodes.notes: One row of probe prerequisites: the managed Anthropic key (get_anthropic_key(), migration 034), the cheapest tier agent (Haiku — the clickup MCP is registered on every tier agent, so the model is irrelevant to connectivity but Haiku minimises probe cost), the persistent environment id (config.managed_agent_environment_id), and Franciszek's active per-user ClickUp Vault id (a stable, always-onboarded probe identity; user_data_and_config). A missing prerequisite -> Run ClickUp Probe returns verdict prereq_missing -> CRITICAL (we cannot even probe). Read-only.

nodes.name: Run ClickUp Probe
nodes.notes: Opens a REAL managed session (agent + environment + Franciszek's ClickUp vault) and asks the agent to call ONLY clickup_get_workspace_hierarchy, then polls session events up to ~48s. Emits a single {verdict} item (does NOT raw-throw for classified cases) routed by Route Probe Verdict. VERDICTS: healthy = clickup_* ran in-harness (agent.mcp_tool_use) OR inconclusive steering-miss (no alarm). clickup_down = genuine ClickUp connectivity failure — tool denied / routed as client custom tool (the 2026-07-01 shape) / session error -> CRITICAL clickup-mcp/health. session_api_down = the Anthropic Managed-Agents SESSION API (create or send) failed after 3 retries (~3s backoff, mirrors prod Execute Agent Session maxTries:3) -> WARN managed-agents/session-api, NOT a ClickUp CRITICAL (fixes the transient-500 misfire, exec 7757). prereq_missing = a probe prerequisite was absent -> CRITICAL (cannot probe). onError=continueErrorOutput remains as a catch-all for any UNEXPECTED exception -> error output -> CRITICAL. Uses this.helpers.httpRequest (crypto/$env blocked here; not needed — key arrives in item data).

nodes.name: Route Probe Verdict
nodes.notes: Fans the probe verdict to the right terminal (normal node, visually inspectable per CLAUDE.md). healthy -> Healthy (silent); clickup_down -> Alert ClickUp MCP Down (CRITICAL); prereq_missing -> Alert ClickUp MCP Down (CRITICAL, cannot probe); session_api_down -> Alert Session API Degraded (WARN, Anthropic session API, not ClickUp). Fallback (unknown verdict) -> Healthy, to avoid a false alarm.

nodes.name: Healthy
nodes.notes: Terminal for the healthy (or inconclusive-no-alarm, or unknown-verdict fallback) path. Silent on purpose — a healthy probe must NOT post to the Alerts task every 6h.

nodes.name: Alert ClickUp MCP Down
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1) seam (ADR-025) for a GENUINE ClickUp connectivity failure (verdict clickup_down: tools denied / routed as client custom tool / session error), a missing probe prerequisite (verdict prereq_missing), or an UNEXPECTED probe exception (Code node error output). While this fails, tier agents lose caller-scoped ClickUp discovery/doc reading -> deliverables silently degrade. Check status.clickup.com, that mcp.clickup.com resolves, and whether Franciszek's ClickUp token is still valid (re-run clickup-oauth-start if revoked). NOTE: a transient Anthropic session-API 500 is NO LONGER routed here — that is session_api_down -> WARN managed-agents/session-api.

value.message: Sonda ClickUp MCP nie powiodla sie — hostowany serwer MCP nie polaczyl sie w realnej sesji (narzedzia ClickUp niedostepne dla agentow).
value.details: =Blad: {{ $json.details || (($json.error || {}).message) || $json.error || JSON.stringify($json).slice(0,400) }}. Gdy ClickUp MCP nie laczy sie, wszystkie tiery traca zakresowane wyszukiwanie/odczyt ClickUp (discovery + dokumenty), a wynik cichego biegu jest gorszy lub pusty. Sprawdz status.clickup.com, rozwiazywanie mcp.clickup.com oraz waznosc tokenu ClickUp Franciszka (clickup-oauth-start jesli odwolany).

nodes.name: Alert Session API Degraded
nodes.notes: WARN via Post Alert (v1) seam (ADR-025) when the Anthropic Managed-Agents SESSION API failed to create or send a probe session after 3 retries (verdict session_api_down). This is an Anthropic-side infra error, NOT a ClickUp MCP outage — so it is a WARN on a distinct source (managed-agents/session-api), not a ClickUp CRITICAL. Real tasks retry the same POSTs (Execute Agent Session maxTries:3), so blast radius may be limited to this probe beat. Introduced to stop the transient-500 misfire (exec 7757, 2026-07-02) that repeatedly mislabelled an Anthropic blip as a ClickUp outage.
